links.outcome: Effect of prompt design (case series data, anti-hallucination instructions) on output grounding
links.effect: Providing Bradford Hill descriptions, including case series data, and adding explicit anti-hallucination instructions improved specificity and grounding; annotators agreed with 79–92% of output sentences.
links.quote: Prompt design substantially influenced output quality; providing Bradford Hill viewpoint descriptions, including case series data, and adding explicit anti-hallucination instructions improved specificity and grounding.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM causality assessment sentences judged by human annotators
links.effect: Annotators agreed with 79–92% of LLM output sentences; full disagreement 3–7%, mostly misinterpretation of report details rather than fabrication.
links.quote: Across all five combinations, annotators agreed with 79–92% of the LLM’s output sentences.
